Peppino gains Area bonus for every level in the

, which is often associated in nature with plants. The next term for this sequence is the sum of the last two term, for example, the final level it receives the bonus is at 21, which equal to 8 + 13 from the last two level threshold. However, Peppino stopped getting more stats at further terms of the sequence, which would have been at level 34 (13 + 21) and so on.
Peppino has one single sprite and is the only character without animation when moving. However, Peppino's December skin has an idle animation, where its ornaments light up.
Peppino is the first character to have its height exceed the top border of their character selection button.

Cute Molisano.

Peppino has eight fruits on its default skin. On its December skin, it has 17 Christmas LEDs.
